codes.name: Invalid

codes.name: Refused
codes.summary: legal but refused by policy or a safety floor

codes.name: Unprovable
codes.summary: identity could not be proven; failed closed (§4.10)

codes.name: Precondition
codes.summary: a precondition of a multi-step operation no longer holds

codes.name: Busy

codes.name: TargetUnreachable
codes.summary: a configured storage target could not be reached

codes.name: EventCursorLost
codes.summary: resume cursor evicted from the bounded event buffer

note: `code` is transport-level and may be added to or subdivided. `stable_slug` is the AC-56 contract: it is what `shepctl --json` puts in `error.code`, and it never changes meaning. Several codes may share one slug. A client that receives an unrecognised code reports the slug `unknown_error` rather than failing to parse.
